title: NVIDIA Enters Pharma: BMS Readies 576 GPUs as Lilly Commits Up to $1 Billion
summary: BMS is preparing to deploy what NVIDIA's published specifications imply is a 576-GPU Rubin system, while Lilly and NVIDIA plan to commit up to $1 billion over five years. The real contest is whether proprietary data, wet-lab execution and clinical evidence can become one learning loop.
